name: Engine Simulator
desc:
🔧 Build the ULTIMATE engine!
❤️ Enjoying the game? LIKE & FAVORITE to support us!

🏎️ Buy engines and test their power  
⬆️ Upgrade your engines for better performance  
⚡ Accelerate and reach MAX RPM  
🏁 Test your horsepower on the Dyno  
💰 Earn money and unlock better engines  

❤️ Made with love from Playbeam.

llm.loop: buy engines -> test on dyno and reach max RPM -> earn money -> upgrade engines -> unlock better engines
llm.objectives: build the ultimate engine with the most horsepower
llm.instructions: buy engines, upgrade them, accelerate to max RPM, test horsepower on the dyno, earn money
unique: engine dyno tuning as an incremental simulator
llm.thumbnails: rendered V8 and V-twin engines with Engine Simulator logo, Build/Upgrade/Dyno buttons
llm.complexity_notes: engine models and upgrade stats, dyno UI; scope otherwise unclear
